levels.name: Software Engineer
levels.description: Owns assigned engineering work, collaborates effectively, learns from feedback, and follows through on quality and reliability.

levels.name: Senior Software Engineer
levels.description: Owns ambiguous technical problems, raises team quality, mentors peers, and influences delivery beyond assigned tasks.

levels.name: Tech Lead
levels.description: Guides technical direction across a team or project, coordinates peers without formal authority, and makes pragmatic trade-offs visible.

levels.name: Engineering Manager
levels.description: Builds a healthy team, coaches engineers, manages delivery, resolves team conflict, and communicates with stakeholders.

levels.name: Senior Engineering Manager
levels.description: Manages managers or multiple teams, scales execution systems, calibrates leadership, and handles cross-team trade-offs.

levels.name: Senior Manager
levels.description: Owns outcomes across one or more teams and develops managers or senior ICs.

levels.name: Director
levels.description: Owns cross-team execution, leadership calibration, and functional alignment.

levels.name: VP Engineering
levels.description: Owns organizational execution, portfolio trade-offs, leadership systems, and executive alignment.

levels.name: CTO
levels.description: Owns company-level technology strategy, trust, risk, executive communication, and long-term leverage.

levels.name: Product Manager
levels.description: Owns customer problems, product discovery, prioritization, execution trade-offs, and stakeholder alignment for a product area.

levels.name: Senior Product Manager
levels.description: Owns ambiguous product opportunities, cross-functional influence, product judgment, and measurable product outcomes across a larger scope.

levels.name: Group Product Manager
levels.description: Leads product direction across multiple PMs or product areas, balancing portfolio choices, customer insight, and cross-functional execution.

levels.name: Director of Product
levels.description: Owns product strategy, team-of-teams alignment, portfolio prioritization, and business/customer outcomes across a product domain.

levels.name: VP Product
levels.description: Owns product portfolio strategy, company-level product trade-offs, executive alignment, market positioning, and durable product operating mechanisms.
